service "grafana" {
  image = "fn61/grafana"
  version = "20181220_1152_030fca37"
  replicas = null
  how_to_update = "stop-old-first"
  placement_node_hostname = "myserver.fn61.net"
  ingress_public {
    port = 80
    rule = "Host:grafana.example.com"
  }
  net {
    mode = "host"
  }
  ram_mb = 16

  backup {
    command = ""
  }

  persistentvolume {
    name = "perkele"
    target = "/data"
  }
}

-------------
services:
  grafana:
    deploy:
      labels:
        edgerouter.auth: public
        traefik.frontend.rule: Host:grafana.example.com
        traefik.port: "80"
        ubackup.command: ""
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: "16777216"
      placement:
        constraints:
        - node.hostname == myserver.fn61.net
    environment:
      LOGGER_SUPPRESS_TIMESTAMPS: "1"
    image: fn61/grafana:20181220_1152_030fca37
    labels:
      edgerouter.auth: public
      traefik.frontend.rule: Host:grafana.example.com
      traefik.port: "80"
      ubackup.command: ""
    network_mode: host
    restart: on-failure
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: perkele
      target: /data
volumes:
  perkele: {}
